info.title: Test analytics
info.description: Test analytics for the 'contoso' organization (REST API 7.1). Generated by azdo-manuals from the Analytics service's OData metadata. Authenticates with the PAT in AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT.

tools.name: query_work_item_snapshot
tools.description: Query WorkItemSnapshot (WorkItemSnapshot) in Analytics with OData. Answers {"value": [rows]}; a long answer comes in pages, and "@odata.nextLink" holds the $skiptoken for the next page. A large set: filter on DateSK (a date as yyyyMMdd, e.g. $filter=DateSK ge 20260101), or the query may not answer. Snapshots are meant for aggregation: $apply=filter(DateSK ge 20260101)/groupby((Property), aggregate($count as Count)).

$apply.description: OData aggregation, e.g. filter(...)/groupby((Property), aggregate($count as Count)).

$count.description: Also return the number of matching rows (@odata.count).

$filter.description: OData filter, e.g. DateSK eq 'value' and ... (same properties as $select).

$orderby.description: Properties to sort by, e.g. Property desc.

$select.description: Comma-separated properties to return. Properties: DateSK (Int32), WorkItemId (Int32), State (String).

$skiptoken.description: The next page's token, from the previous answer's @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: query_work_items
tools.description: Current state of work items & their fields. Query Work Items (WorkItems) in Analytics with OData. Answers {"value": [rows]}; a long answer comes in pages, and "@odata.nextLink" holds the $skiptoken for the next page.

$apply.description: OData aggregation, e.g. filter(...)/groupby((Property), aggregate($count as Count)).

$count.description: Also return the number of matching rows (@odata.count).

$expand.description: Related entities to include, e.g. Name($select=...). Navigation properties: Area, Children.

$filter.description: OData filter, e.g. WorkItemId eq 'value' and ... (same properties as $select).

$orderby.description: Properties to sort by, e.g. Property desc.

$select.description: Comma-separated properties to return. Properties: WorkItemId (Int32), Title (String), State (String), ChangedDate (DateTimeOffset), and 2 custom fields named Custom_<field> (their reference names are in the WorkItemTypeFields entity set).

$skiptoken.description: The next page's token, from the previous answer's @odata.nextLink.
